name: Sky Sliders for Elementor
author: wowDevs

sections.description:
Sky Sliders adds eight ready-made slider widgets to Elementor. Drag one onto a page, add your slides, style it in the panel and publish. No code, no shortcodes.

Every slider is responsive, swipes on touch screens, and loads its CSS and JS only on pages that use it.

Free sliders

Advanced Slider
One widget with five transitions and nine aspect ratios. Image, video or dynamic slides (posts or an ACF repeater) with a content box styled from your global colors and fonts.

Creative Slider
Cinematic reveals for hero sections. Pick a curtain, circle, wipe or fade, then animate the title by letters, words or a clip.

Elegant Carousel
A centered card carousel for portfolios and case studies. The cards out of focus fade so the active one leads.

Fluid Slider
A split hero with a two part title, a badge and a button. Soft shapes float behind the photo and parallax moves every layer on its own.

Lucid Slider
A full screen hero with two color layers that sweep in behind every slide, parallax text and one clear button.

Minimal Slider
A quiet full width slider for brands that like white space. Clear type, text arrows and one button per slide.

Photography Slider
A photo first slider with a split title, a big outline word and a row of links.

Vibrant Slider
A bold full screen slider with big type, parallax and mousewheel control.

In every slider

  • Drag and drop — find it in the Elementor panel and place it on any page, post or template.
  • Responsive — desktop, tablet and mobile, with touch swipe.
  • Styled in Elementor — colors, typography, spacing, borders and height in the Style tab.
  • Autoplay and loop — delay and transition speed per widget.
  • Arrows and pagination — show or hide each one per widget.
  • SEO friendly titles — pick the HTML tag (H1–H6, div, span or p) for slide titles.
  • Light — a slider’s CSS and JS load only on pages that use it.
  • Turn sliders off — Sky Sliders → Widgets switches off the sliders you don’t use.

Sky Sliders Pro

Sky Sliders Pro is an add-on that runs on top of this plugin. It adds ten sliders with WebGL and Swiper 11 effects and content animation (Cascade, Drift Carousel, Folio, Halo, Mirage, Mosaic, Origami, Prism, Ribbon and Strata) and Dynamic Posts in Creative, Elegant Carousel, Fluid, Lucid, Minimal and Vibrant.

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.8 or later
  • Elementor 3.0.0 or later (free or Pro)
  • PHP 7.4 or later
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins → Add New, search for Sky Sliders for Elementor, click Install Now, then Activate.
  2. Or upload the ZIP under Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin, or copy the sky-sliders-lite folder to /wp-content/plugins/ and activate it.
  3. Open a page in Elementor, search for a slider (for example “Minimal”) in the panel and drag it onto the page.
  4. Add your slides in the Content tab, style them in the Style tab, and publish.
sections.faq:
Does it work without Elementor?

No. Sky Sliders is an Elementor add-on and needs Elementor (free or Pro) 3.0.0 or later.

Is it free?

Yes. All eight sliders above are free, with no account needed. Sky Sliders Pro is optional.

Will the sliders work on mobile?

Yes. Every slider is responsive and supports touch swipe on phones and tablets.

Can I use it as a full screen hero slider?

Yes. Set the height in px, vh, em or rem, or use Aspect Ratio in the Advanced Slider.

Can I build slides from my posts?

Yes, in the Advanced Slider (posts or an ACF repeater). In the other sliders, Dynamic Posts comes with Sky Sliders Pro.

How do I turn on autoplay?

Select the slider, open the Settings section in the Content tab, switch Autoplay on and set the delay and speed.

Does it slow down pages that don’t use a slider?

No. Elementor loads a slider’s CSS and JS only on pages that contain it.

I use Sky Sliders Pro 1.0.x. What happens?

Update Sky Sliders Pro to 1.1 and keep both plugins active: Pro 1.1 runs on top of this plugin. Your sliders and settings are kept. While Pro 1.0.x is still active, this plugin pauses itself and asks you to update Pro.

Where can I report a bug or request a feature?

Use the support forum on this plugin’s WordPress.org page, or open an issue on GitHub.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • Improved: This plugin is now the Sky Sliders core; Sky Sliders Pro 1.1 runs on top of it as an add-on.
  • Added: Advanced, Fluid and Vibrant sliders now work in the free plugin (listed in 1.0.3, but never loaded).
  • Added: Creative Slider, Elegant Carousel and Lucid Slider are now free. Existing pages keep their settings.
  • Added: Advanced Slider — slides from posts or an ACF repeater, per-slide video, Aspect Ratio, new default design.
  • Added: Fluid Slider — per-slide video, four transitions, Pause on Hover, Keyboard, Mousewheel, more style controls.
  • Added: Minimal Slider — Slide, Fade or Zoom transitions, Pause on Hover, Keyboard and Mousewheel.
  • Added: Vibrant Slider — Slide, Fade or Zoom transitions and Pause on Hover.
  • Added: Photography Slider — Pause on Hover, Keyboard and Mousewheel.
  • Added: Dynamic Posts in Creative, Elegant Carousel, Fluid, Lucid, Minimal and Vibrant with Sky Sliders Pro.
  • Added: Every slider has its own icon on the dashboard and in the Elementor panel.
  • Added: Get PRO and Help & Support pages under the Sky Sliders menu.
  • Fixed: Minimal Slider — slide video covered the text; the active-dot ring filled in a flash at the end.
  • Fixed: Minimal Slider — Border hover colour and Custom image size had no effect; dots overlapped arrows on phones.
  • Fixed: Minimal Slider — a new-tab or nofollow title link was passed on to the other slides.
  • Fixed: Photography Slider — clicking a dot stopped autoplay; Custom image size was ignored.
  • Fixed: Photography Slider — PHP warning on a slide without an image; outline text read twice by screen readers.
  • Fixed: With Sky Sliders Pro 1.0.x active, this plugin now pauses and asks to update Pro instead of breaking the site.

1.0.3

  • Improved plugin structure and build pipeline.
  • Per-widget asset loading — CSS and JS only load on pages using the widget.
  • Text domain corrected for WordPress.org compatibility.
  • Fixed wp_redirect() replaced with wp_safe_redirect() in duplicator utility.
  • Code quality improvements for WordPress Plugin Check compliance.

1.0.0

  • Initial release with Minimal and Photography slider widgets.
